title: git.infrawrench.com and Infrawrench CI
summary: Works in a repository on git.infrawrench.com the way its reviewers read it: records the work on each push, answers what they send back, and writes CI jobs that put notes on the branch's page.
description: Work in a Git repository hosted on git.infrawrench.com (its remote is git.infrawrench.com) and with Infrawrench CI (.infrawrench/ci/*.yml). Use when writing or reviewing code on a branch there, when the infrawrench-git MCP server is connected or should be, when asked to record a trace, answer reviewer instructions or report findings, or when writing a CI job that should leave must-fix, should-fix, note, doubt, decision, step or evidence notes on a branch's page.
